definitions.explanation: A liquid food made by boiling meat, vegetables, or other ingredients in water, typically Western-style.

examples.japanese: {温|あたた}かいスープが{飲|の}みたい。
examples.english: I want to drink warm soup.

examples.japanese: コーンスープが{好|す}きだ。
ラーメンのスープが{美味|おい}しい。

notes:
スープ typically refers to Western-style soups. For Japanese-style soup, {汁|しる} or {汁物|しるもの} is used, though スープ can also refer to ramen broth.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- スープを{作|つく}る: to make soup
- スープを{飲|の}む: to drink soup
- コーンスープ: corn soup
- オニオンスープ: onion soup
- ポタージュスープ: potage soup
- スープ{皿|ざら}: soup bowl

RELATED WORDS:
- {味噌汁|みそしる}: miso soup
- {汁物|しるもの}: soup (Japanese-style)
- シチュー: stew
